A potted split-leaf plant sits beside her, with a towel-draped lounger nearby. Curved clothing bands and long deck planks provide distinct sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Ankha in Nook's Cranny Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Ankha inside Nook's Cranny, standing in a simple dress with a wide collar in front of the shop's arched doorway. A cash register and lamp occupy the counter, while shelves display a shell and small ornaments. The coloring sheet leaves broad spaces across the outfit and floorboards.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Ankha in Apple Orchard Coloring Page
pages.description: Ankha sits on a wooden stool in an apple orchard in this printable coloring page, smiling with closed eyes beneath her cobra head ornament. Rows of fruit-laden trees surround her striped tail and pleated dress. The coloring sheet pairs large face and clothing areas with smaller apples, leaves, and stool details.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Ankha in Cedar Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Animal Crossing's Ankha in a cedar forest, standing with folded arms among tall trees, low shrubs, and scattered stones. Her cobra ornament, layered collar, and patterned dress add smaller enclosed sections to the coloring sheet, while her face and the tree trunks offer broader spaces.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Ankha at Campsite Coloring Page
pages.description: Animal Crossing's Ankha raises one paw at a campsite in this printable coloring page, with a pitched tent, hanging lantern, and campfire behind her. Her simple dress creates a broad central coloring area. Smaller sections appear in her decorative collar, striped tail, tent ropes, and the logs on this outdoor coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Ankha on Sandy Beach Coloring Page
pages.description: Ankha stands on a sandy beach in this printable coloring page, with gentle waves, a curved shoreline, and a coconut palm in the background. Her large face, plain dress, and upright ears leave spacious areas to color. The coloring sheet adds smaller bands along her curled tail and head covering.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Ankha in Market Street Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a close view of Animal Crossing's Ankha on a market street, framed by striped awnings, pottery, and a bread stall. Her cobra ornament and segmented collar remain prominent above the cobbled walkway. Broad facial areas contrast with the smaller shop details across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Ankha at Fireworks Show Coloring Page
pages.description: Ankha looks up at a fireworks show in this printable coloring page, wearing a layered dress and a cobra ornament beneath large bursts overhead. Small festival stalls and two distant animal figures sit behind her. The coloring sheet combines long firework shapes with narrower sections in her collar, dress, and striped tail.

pages.title: Animal Crossing Ankha in Seaside Village Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Animal Crossing's Ankha seated in a seaside village, with a patterned dress, upright ears, and a striped tail beside her. pages.title: Animal Crossing Ankha in Art Gallery Coloring Page
pages.description: Ankha stands with her paws together in an art gallery in this printable coloring page, with a landscape painting and an abstract picture behind her. Her patterned dress, layered collar, and striped tail add distinct sections to the coloring sheet. The tiled floor and open walls leave larger spaces around the figure.
